en:
Hey, Kaede. Why do you keep talking 
to someone like me?

Why...? Is that a problem?
Oh, do you have other plans?
It's nothing like that...
Then, what do you mean?
Don't bother with me.
"Don't bother with me"...?

It seems you've forgotten, so I'll remind you.
I'm a murderer.

I warned you about walking up to 
a killer like me.
Oh yeah, you did tell me that...
You've got a blank look on your face...

Well...I've never been in this situation
before.

Now if you had a contagious cold, I'd be
more careful about avoiding you.

We were forced into a killing game, 
but you're not wary of murderers?

I trust you...and I don't think everyone in
our group has killed before.
Hmph...so that's the way you live, huh?

Anyway, about your "Don't bother with me"
attitude...

Do you just say that because you think
it makes you sound cool?
Huh?

Of course, your past is something you can
never take back...

But you've accepted your crime, and now
you're making up for it as a prisoner, right?
Yeah, I am...

I don't think a person like that should bear
such a burden alone.
Or...are you like the edgiest of edgelords?

Are you gonna say something like, "My right
arm trembles with the power of darkness"!?
Do I really look like that kind of guy...?
No, you don't.

But...you've been sulking this whole time, so
I'm starting to see you that way.
I'm...sulking?

Well, I didn't expect to hear that. Even though
you judged me based on my appearance.
Well, that's... Yeah, you're right...
But...I'm sulking, huh? Maybe...
You might not be wrong.
<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma let out a huge sigh.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL>, huh...?

Your words and voice...inspire people's hearts
...like the melody of a piano.
Huh...?

Anyway, don't bother with me anymore.
You got it?
<CLT=cltMIND>And there he goes...

<CLT=cltMIND>But the way he said that...
Did my words reach Ryoma?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Ryoma's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Ryoma, I returned
to my room.
